entries.description: One entry for each shown record and each open card question the message answers; nothing for the ones it does not touch.

id.description: The record id as shown, or the card question id as given.

hash.description: The hash of the record as shown; empty for a card question.

option.description: For a card with choices: the label of the choice the person's words pick, copied from its choices, even when they name it in other words; null when they pick none or it is unclear.

change.description: What the owner asked to change, or the chosen version or combination.

option.description: For a card that offers choices: the exact label of the one offered choice the message picks as it stands; null when it picks none or asks for a change to it.

evidence.description: The owner's exact words that carry this answer, copied from the message.
